10.sourceTitle: Schwalbe Clik Valve | H&S Bike-Discount GmbH
10.evidenceText: Multiple prices found across sources: RRP 49,99 €/33,99 €, 16,95 €/11,99 €, 5,95 €/3,79 €, 16,95 €/9,99 € (bike-discount.de); €11.95, €13.99, €11.90 (ebike24.com). Median of all 11 prices = 11.99 €
10.extractionRationale: Extracted median price from 11 distinct retail prices found across two sources. Source 1 lists multiple Clik Valve products with RRP and sale prices. Source 2 lists regular and sale prices for retrofit kits. All prices converted to EUR and sorted to find median value of 11.99 EUR.

27.evidenceText: Source 1: Schwalbe Schlauch Nr. 12 with Clik Valve (SCV); Source 2: Schwalbe Clik Valve Tubeless-Ventil 2er Set 60mm; Source 3: Schwalbe Schlauch Nr. 7 with Clik Valve (SCV); Source 4: Schwalbe Schlauch Nr. 15 with Clik Valve (SCV). Source 5 is an accessory kit with pump head adapter and was excluded.
27.extractionRationale: Counted unique product page URLs for Clik Valve products on bike24.de. Identified 4 distinct product listings: 3 different sizes of Schwalbe tubes with Clik Valve (p1962380, p1962299, p1962278) and 1 standalone Clik Valve tubeless valve set (p1859949). Excluded Source 5 (p1859953) as it is an accessory/conversion kit with pump head adapter, not a primary product listing.

30.evidenceText: None of the three product listings contain explicit stock status indicators such as 'out of stock', 'currently unavailable', 'nicht verfügbar', or 'ausverkauft'.
30.extractionRationale: The provided content from all three sources does not include any stock status indicators. Source 1 shows product navigation and reviews information but no availability status. Source 2 and 3 contain incomplete content (navigation menus and JavaScript error screens). Therefore, stock status cannot be determined from the available text.

56.evidenceText: Numerous butyl tubes with CLIK VALVE are now available: The SCV butyl tubes No. 3, 4, 6, 7, 10, 12, 13, 15, 17, and 19 are equipped with the Schwalbe Clik Valve as standard
56.extractionRationale: Source 3 explicitly lists all SCV butyl tubes equipped with Clik Valve as standard. Counting the tube numbers (3, 4, 6, 7, 10, 12, 13, 15, 17, 19) yields 10 distinct inner tube models. This is the authoritative source directly stating which tubes use the Clik valve interface.
